candidates.description: This vector represents terminology and concepts associated with the sport of baseball.
This vector represents adjectives and qualifiers denoting significance, variety, or magnitude in Spanish.
These tokens function as Spanish (and some Italian or French) relative pronouns, conjunctions, and interrogative adverbs used to introduce subordinate clauses or ask questions.
This vector represents Spanish words and roots containing the letter sequence "qu".
This vector represents common adjectives and evaluative terms frequently used to express subjective judgments or states.
This feature vector represents sports, athletic games, and related leagues or equipment.
These tokens represent common Spanish action verbs in their infinitive forms.
This feature vector activates strongly in the context of professional sports teams, leagues, and related terminology.
This vector represents adjectives of degree, emphasis, or factual state used to modify nouns.
This vector represents common Spanish nouns used in frequent adverbial, prepositional, and structural phrases.
